methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. All USD figures reflect self-serve published rates. 'monthlyUsd' for annual plans is the annualized monthly rate (annual total divided by 12); month-to-month rates are noted where published. Stackify Retrace was excluded because it is in end-of-life maintenance mode (EOL March 31, 2027) with no meaningful new-customer pricing. AppSignal pricing was sourced from GetApp (reputable aggregator) because the official /plans page returned HTTP 500; noted in provenance. New Relic HIPAA eligibility requires the Data Plus add-on per official documentation. Dynatrace uses a fully consumption-based DPS model; the 'Full-Stack Monitoring' tier ($58/mo per 8-GiB host) is the primary APM entry point. Grafana Cloud has a $19/month platform fee on the Pro tier on top of usage costs; the flat $19 is used as monthlyUsd for the Pro plan. SigNoz Teams plan includes $49 of usage credits per month. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on all plans as this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Datadog APM
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.datadoghq.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA confirmed via Datadog Trust Center at https://trust.datadoghq.com/ (lists HIPAA certification). Prices are per-host per month; standalone APM tiers are priced without bundled infrastructure monitoring.

plans.name: APM (with Infra)
plans.notes: Annual commitment rate: $31/host/month. On-demand (month-to-month): $48/host/month. Includes infrastructure monitoring and end-to-end distributed traces.

plans.name: APM Pro (with Infra)
plans.notes: Annual commitment rate: $35/host/month. On-demand: $54/host/month. Adds Data Streams Monitoring for streaming data pipelines.

plans.name: APM Enterprise (with Infra)
plans.notes: Annual commitment rate: $40/host/month. On-demand: $60/host/month. Adds Continuous Profiler (code-level CPU/IO/memory tracing).

plans.name: APM Standalone
plans.notes: Annual rate: $36/host/month without bundled infrastructure monitoring. Standalone APM Pro: $41/host/month. Standalone APM Enterprise: $47/host/month.

vendors.name: New Relic
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://newrelic.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA eligibility is available on the Data Plus data option (noted on pricing page: 'FedRAMP Moderate and HIPAA eligibility with Data Plus'). BAA available for qualifying accounts. Pricing is consumption-based: data ingestion cost + per-user cost.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 GB data ingest/month, 1 full platform user, unlimited basic users, 8-day minimum data retention. No credit card required.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: First full platform user: $10/month. Additional full platform users: $99/month each (max 5 users on Standard). Core users: $49/user/month. Data ingest: $0.40/GB beyond 100 GB free. Up to 5 full platform users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Full platform user: $349/user/month (annual) or $418.80/user/month (pay-as-you-go). Core users: $49/user/month. Data ingest: $0.40/GB beyond 100 GB free (Original) or $0.60/GB (Data Plus). Unlimited full platform users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Includes FedRAMP Moderate and HIPAA eligibility with Data Plus, 1-hour critical support SLA.

vendors.name: Grafana Cloud
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://grafana.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA status could not be confirmed from publicly accessible pages; set to null. Grafana Cloud pricing is composable and usage-based beyond the $19/month Pro platform fee.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 10k active metrics series (14-day retention), 50 GB logs/traces ingested (14-day retention), 2,232 host hours Kubernetes monitoring, 50k frontend sessions. Always free, no credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $19/month platform fee plus usage-based costs: metrics $6.50/1k series, logs $0.50/GB (write+process), traces $0.50/GB, Kubernetes monitoring $0.01/host-hour (~$7.20/host/month), application observability $0.025/host-hour (~$18/host/month), Grafana visualization $8/active-user, IRM $20/active-user. 30-day retention on logs/traces.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Annual commit starting at $25,000/year. Volume discounts: metrics from $3/1k series, custom retention. Includes enterprise plugins, priority support.

vendors.name: Honeycomb
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.honeycomb.io/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA status: enterprise page mentions 'advanced security and compliance' but does not explicitly confirm HIPAA or BAA on public pages; set to null. Integrations sourced from https://www.honeycomb.io/integrations fetched 2026-06-14.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 20 million events/month. Includes distributed tracing, BubbleUp, OpenTelemetry support, Canvas AI Copilot, Honeycomb MCP, 2 Triggers. Best for testing and individual projects.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Starting at $130/month. Up to 1.5 billion events/month. Includes 100 Triggers, 2 SLOs, Single Sign-On. Monthly or annual subscription. Best for teams with a production application.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, contact sales. Base allowance of 10 billion events/year. 300+ Triggers, 100 SLOs, Service Map, Query Data API, AWS PrivateLink, enterprise-grade support and onboarding.

vendors.name: Dynatrace
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.dynatrace.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA status could not be confirmed from public pages (trust center returned 404); set to null. Dynatrace uses a consumption-based Davis Platform Subscription (DPS) model billed per hour; monthly figures shown are approximations at the stated hourly rates for a 720-hour month.

plans.name: Foundation & Discovery
plans.notes: $7/month per host ($0.01/hour). Basic infrastructure monitoring and IT inventory. Not a full APM tier.

plans.name: Infrastructure Monitoring
plans.notes: $29/month per host ($0.04/hour). Cloud and data center infrastructure observability.

plans.name: Full-Stack Monitoring
plans.notes: $58/month per 8-GiB host ($0.01/memory-GiB-hour). Comprehensive APM + infrastructure observability including automatic distributed tracing (PurePath), AI-powered root cause analysis (Davis AI), and service topology mapping.

plans.name: Kubernetes Platform Monitoring
plans.notes: $1.40/month per pod ($0.002/hour per pod). Kubernetes cluster visibility add-on.

vendors.name: AppSignal
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.appsignal.com/plans returned HTTP 500. Prices sourced from GetApp aggregator listing at https://www.getapp.com/it-management-software/a/appsignal/pricing/ (reputable B2B software directory), fetched 2026-06-14. 10% annual discount noted by GetApp. HIPAA available as optional paid add-on per GetApp listing.

plans.name: Standard

plans.name: Professional

plans.name: Business

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $239/month. 25M requests/month. Save 10% on annual plan.

plans.name: Premium Enterprise
plans.notes: $309/month. 50M requests/month. Save 10% on annual plan.

plans.name: Ultimate

vendors.name: Sentry
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://sentry.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches confirmed consistent data). HIPAA attestation confirmed via https://sentry.io/security/ (SOC2 Type I, SOC2 Type II, HIPAA Attestation, ISO 27001). BAA details require contacting enterprise sales; not confirmed as self-serve, so baa set to null.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free forever. 1 user, 5,000 errors/month, 5M spans/month for tracing, 50 session replays, 10 custom dashboards.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $26/month (annual billing). 50,000 errors/month, 5M spans/month, unlimited users, third-party integrations, 20 dashboards. Monthly billing option available at same stated rate. Additional overages: logs/metrics $0.50/GB beyond included.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $80/month. Unlimited dashboards, metric monitors with anomaly detection, SAML/SCIM support, advanced quota management.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Dedicated TAM, premium support, custom data retention, advanced compliance options.

vendors.name: SigNoz
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://signoz.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 (two separate fetches). HIPAA compliance (SOC2 Type II + HIPAA) and BAA availability confirmed on pricing page: 'SOC2 Type II & HIPAA Compliant' with 'BAA Agreement' listed as an included feature for the Teams plan and above.

plans.name: Community (Self-Hosted)
plans.notes: Open source, free to self-host. No managed support included. Full feature access; user manages own infrastructure.

plans.name: Teams (Cloud)
plans.notes: $49/month base includes $49 of usage credits (~163 GB logs/traces or 490M metric samples). Usage beyond credits: traces $0.30/GB, logs $0.30/GB, metrics $0.10/million samples. Unlimited team members. SOC2 Type II + HIPAA + BAA included. Startup program: $19/month for qualifying companies (<3 years old, <30 employees, <$6M raised).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting at $4,000/month (custom). Dedicated SigNoz Cloud environment, bring-your-own-cloud option, or self-hosted with support contract. Volume discounts, annual contracts, dedicated support, professional services.

vendors.name: Elastic Observability
vendors.provenance: Elastic main pricing page https://www.elastic.co/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14 — returned deployment model overview without specific tier prices. Serverless Observability pricing page https://www.elastic.co/pricing/serverless-observability fetched 2026-06-14 provided ingestion/retention rates. Elastic uses fully usage-based serverless pricing or resource-based hosted pricing; no flat self-serve tiers with fixed USD amounts. HIPAA status could not be confirmed from public pages fetched; set to null.

plans.name: Serverless Observability — Logs Essentials
plans.notes: Usage-based, no fixed monthly floor. Ingest: as low as $0.07/GB. Retention: as low as $0.017/GB/month. Egress: 50 GB free then $0.05/GB. Prices effective November 1, 2025.

plans.name: Serverless Observability — Complete
plans.notes: Usage-based, no fixed monthly floor. Ingest: as low as $0.09/GB. Retention: as low as $0.019/GB/month. Egress: 50 GB free then $0.05/GB. Adds APM, profiling, synthetic monitoring, and full observability features beyond Logs Essentials. Prices effective November 1, 2025.

plans.name: Hosted / Self-Managed
plans.notes: Resource-based pricing for Elastic Cloud Hosted or license-based for self-managed deployments. Prices vary by instance size, region, and commitment. Contact sales or use Elastic's cloud pricing calculator.
